newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks perk up in robust trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks perk up in robust trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks perked up in robust trade on Tuesday, with blue chip drugs firm Pliva selling most shares.
* Of 17 active issues nine rose, four fell and four were flat.
* Volume balooned to 23,228 shares, turnover to 15.9 from 3.4 million kuna.
* Most active Pliva added 18 kuna to 480 on volume of 8,349 shares.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Istraturist firmed 10 kuna to 180, with 340 shares changing hands.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Arenaturist fell to 125 kuna from 140 late in May, selling 57 shares.
